description: This file defines the EntityController class in Drupal, providing entity add-page and title callback functionalities, including methods for redirecting, adding entities, generating titles, and handling bundle descriptions.

classes.name: EntityController
classes.description: Controller class in Drupal providing entity add-page, title callbacks, and bundle management functionalities.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate EntityController with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Returns a RedirectResponse to a specified route with parameters and options.

methods.name: addPage
methods.description: Displays add links for entity bundles or redirects if only one bundle is available.

methods.name: addTitle
methods.description: Generates a title for the add entity page based on entity type.

methods.name: addBundleTitle
methods.description: Generates a title for adding a specific bundle of an entity type.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Returns the label of an entity for view pages.

methods.name: editTitle
methods.description: Returns a title for editing an entity.

methods.name: deleteTitle
methods.description: Returns a title for deleting an entity.

methods.name: doGetEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the entity from route parameters or directly passed entity.

methods.name: loadBundleDescriptions
methods.description: Loads and sorts bundle descriptions for an entity type.
